turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good evening, this is Arjun from Udaan Credit Finance. This call is recorded for quality and compliance. Am I speaking with Mr. Sameer Joshi?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Haan, yes, yes. Sorry, it's a bit noisy here, I'm at the market.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No problem sir. For verification, could you tell me the last four digits of your loan account?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you sir. Your personal loan EMI of seven thousand rupees is due on the fifth. It will be debited automatically.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, yes, it's fine. My brother also took a bike loan last year, he paid it off already, haha.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: This traffic is killing me, honestly. Anyway, the money is in the account.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect. Please keep the balance one day before the due date.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, maybe I'll check the app later, no issues.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your time sir, have a good evening.
